title: Recovered structural systems
subtitle: Fifteen provisional system proposals recovered from older PR branches. Each points to its wiki source. No proposal is automatically promoted to established canon.
schematic: These proposals supplement current canonical owners and must be reviewed against them. Inferred links only, with the working world as orientation rather than a claim of settled content.
about: Supplemental Atlas coverage for recovered pages in PR #20; current canon always wins.
